note: Phase 6 performance budgets. Raising a number is a reviewed decision (see docs/OPERATIONS.md). Sizes are bytes; gzip measured with zlib level 9 (close to what Netlify serves). Measured at Phase 6: JS 195 KB gzip, build 0.2 ms, insights 0.4 ms (node). JS budget = measured + ~8% headroom; lower it when code is trimmed. Trait lab (Oct 2026): +8.0 KB gzip (203.9 -> 211.9 KB), limit raised 210000 -> 214000 pending owner review. Compatibility/group tools (Oct 2026): +8.6 KB gzip (211.9 -> 220.5 KB), these tools were then moved to tools-lazy.js (loaded on demand): first load is 204.9 KB again, so the limit is back at 210000, and the lazy file (18.7 KB gzip) has its own budget.

lazy.note: Files fetched on demand (Patterns, Compare, Group), not on first paint: tools-lazy.js. Counted separately so moving code out of the first load is visible, not hidden.

compute_ms_median.note: Node, 30 runs on a CI-class machine. A low-end phone is roughly 4-6x slower, so these keep the report under ~0.4 s there.
